# WYNC News

WYNC News is a broadcast news organization offering breaking news coverage, weather reporting with Doppler radar technology, and dedicated news and weather teams. The brand carries the authoritative, fast-paced energy of a professional TV news station, combining hard-hitting journalism with real-time meteorological updates.

## Our Services



Three pillars of rapid, reliable reporting designed to keep you informed, prepared, and safe.












### Breaking News Monitoring


Our 24/7 assignment desk scans police scanners, emergency channels, and verified social feeds so you never miss a critical moment. We prioritize accuracy over speed, ensuring every alert you receive is confirmed by our in-house editorial team before it reaches your screen.









### Field Reporting & Verification


When news breaks, our mobile journalists deploy immediately to bring you live, on-the-ground perspective. Every report undergoes a rigorous fact-checking process, cross-referencing official sources and eyewitness accounts to deliver the most reliable narrative available.









### Commuter-Impact Summaries


Designed for residents and travelers alike, our commuter-impact summaries translate breaking events into actionable information. We track road closures, transit delays, and emergency detours, integrating local Doppler radar weather data so you can plan your route with confidence.

WYNC Doppler Radar

# Your trusted local doppler radar weather coverage


Count on WYNC News for dependable local weather coverage that keeps you prepared for every day, every storm, and every emergency. Our Doppler radar technology delivers real-time updates so you can plan ahead with confidence and stay aware when conditions change.


View Forecast
Live Radar Map
















## Our Weather Capabilities









### Doppler Radar Tracking


Our advanced local doppler radar weather system scans the skies in real-time, detecting precipitation intensity, storm rotation, and wind patterns. We provide minute-by-minute updates so you always know what's heading your way.







### Neighborhood Forecast Interpretation


Weather doesn't affect every street the same way. Our meteorologists break down the doppler radar weather map into hyper-local forecasts, translating complex data into clear, actionable insights for your specific community.







### Commute-Focused Weather Guidance


Plan your drive with confidence using our commute-focused weather guidance. We overlay local weather doppler data onto major traffic routes, highlighting slick roads, reduced visibility, and crosswind zones before you leave the driveway.







### Storm-Awareness Communication


When severe weather strikes, every second counts. Our storm-awareness communication delivers instant alerts via broadcast, app notifications, and social media, giving you the critical lead time needed to protect your family and property.















Weather Preparedness




## Smarter Planning, Safer Families



WYNC News combines advanced local doppler radar weather technology with dedicated meteorologists who translate complex data into clear, actionable forecasts. Our mission is to keep you informed, prepared, and safe—whether you're planning tomorrow's commute or protecting your family from severe conditions.










### Commute Confidence


Plan safer routes with hyper-local, minute-by-minute precipitation forecasts. Know exactly when rain or snow will hit your neighborhood.










### Family Preparedness


Receive early warnings for severe thunderstorms, flash floods, and tornadoes. Protect what matters most with our Weather Team's real-time alerts.










### Plain-Language Forecasts


No jargon. Just clear, conversational weather updates. Our team breaks down complex meteorological data into simple terms you can trust.

# Meet the WYNC News Team


Introducing our anchors, reporters, and field correspondents — experienced local storytellers dedicated to accuracy, speed, and public service. Whether delivering breaking news or tracking the latest local doppler radar weather, our team is committed to keeping you informed with clarity and care.

## Our Editorial Values



The principles that guide every story we tell and every forecast we deliver.











### Factual Reporting


We are committed to rigorous verification and sourcing. Every story undergoes a multi-layered editorial review to ensure accuracy, fairness, and context before it reaches our community. In an era of misinformation, our promise is truth you can trust.










### Neighborhood Presence


WYNC is woven into the fabric of our local communities. Our reporters live here, shop here, and raise families here. We don't just cover the neighborhood — we are the neighborhood, bringing you stories that matter from voices you know.










### Timely Communication


When severe weather strikes or breaking news unfolds, seconds count. Our Doppler radar technology and dedicated weather team ensure you receive life-saving alerts and critical updates faster than any other local source, keeping you prepared and protected.















Our People

## On the Ground, In the Community



From severe weather outbreaks to neighborhood investigations, the WYNC News team brings you trusted coverage with local Doppler radar weather expertise and award-winning storytelling.










### Severe Weather Response Reporting


Our Doppler radar weather map team tracked a tornado-warned supercell in real time, providing life-saving alerts and continuous coverage as the storm moved through the metro area.











### School & Civic Emergency Coverage


When a water main break forced school closures, our news team coordinated with city officials to deliver real-time updates and safety instructions to families across three counties.











### Neighborhood Investigative Storytelling


Our investigative unit spent months uncovering housing code violations, using public records and local weather Doppler data to show how flooding risk disproportionately affects underserved communities.

WYNC Weather Team


# Your Calm in the Storm


Our meteorologists don't just read the radar—they live in your community. Using advanced local doppler radar weather technology, we translate complex data into clear, actionable advice. When skies turn gray, our team is here to keep your family safe, prepared, and informed with the warmth of a trusted neighbor.


Meet the Team
View Live Radar






Chief Meteorologist Alex Rivera in the field

















## Our Weather Expertise



Decades of combined experience delivering accurate, life-saving forecasts to the WYNC community.










### Advanced Radar Interpretation


Our meteorologists decode the most complex doppler radar weather map signatures in real time. From hook echoes indicating tornado formation to bow echoes signaling destructive straight-line winds, we translate raw data into clear, actionable intelligence that keeps WYNC viewers safe and informed.










### Severe Weather Communication


When every second counts, clarity saves lives. The WYNC Weather Team specializes in rapid, authoritative severe weather communication, cutting through the noise with station-grade urgency and calm precision. We ensure your family knows exactly what to do before, during, and after the storm.










### Daily Forecast Guidance


From the morning commute to weekend family plans, our local weather doppler expertise powers hyper-local daily forecasts. We track microclimates across the tri-state area, giving you the precise temperature, precipitation, and wind details that national apps simply miss.
















## In the Field, For You








Live from the neighborhoods that matter most.









Our news and weather teams don't just report from the studio — they're on the ground in your community. From breaking news scenes and city council meetings to tracking severe storms with our advanced local doppler radar weather technology, we bring you the story where it happens. When a tornado warning hits or floodwaters rise, our meteorologists are live with the radar weather local viewers need to stay safe.


It's journalism rooted in place, powered by precision, and delivered with the urgency and care your family deserves.














## Success Stories










### Commuter Confidence


When unexpected storms hit the tri-state area, our local doppler radar weather team provided real-time updates that helped thousands of commuters adjust their routes and schedules. By tracking storm cells with precision, WYNC News empowered viewers to avoid dangerous road conditions and arrive safely, reinforcing our commitment to community safety.









### Severe Weather Preparedness


During a record-breaking tornado outbreak, our weather team used advanced doppler radar weather map technology to issue life-saving warnings minutes before touchdowns. Families across the region credited WYNC's clear, calm instructions with giving them the time they needed to seek shelter, transforming fear into informed action.









### Family Forecast Peace of Mind


Parents planning weekend outings rely on our radar weather local forecasts to make confident decisions. By delivering hyper-local updates and hour-by-hour breakdowns, WYNC News has become a trusted partner for families, ensuring that a sudden downpour never ruins a soccer game or a picnic, and that every plan is backed by solid meteorological insight.

# Privacy Policy



Last Updated:  6/5/2026



WYNC News ("Company", "we", "our") is committed to protecting your privacy. This privacy policy explains how we collect, use and protect your information when you use our website [business_website] ("Service").


## 1. Information Collection


We may collect the following types of information:


- Personal Information: Name, email address, phone number and address

- Technical Information: IP address, browser type, operating system and website usage data

- Cookies: Information stored on your computer to improve user experience




## 2. Use of Information


We use the collected information for the following purposes:


- Providing requested services

- Improving service and user experience

- Contacting you regarding our services

- Compliance with legal requirements




## 3. Information Sharing


We do not sell, rent or share your personal information with third parties, except in the following cases:


- With your explicit consent

- When required by law

- To protect our rights or user safety

- With service providers who assist in operating the service (under confidentiality agreements)




## 4. User Rights


In accordance with Israeli Privacy Protection Law 1981, you have the following rights:


- Right to access personal information stored about you

- Right to correct inaccurate or incomplete information

- Right to delete personal information in certain circumstances

- Right to object to information processing for marketing purposes

- Right to file a complaint with the Data Protection Authority




## 5. Cookies


Our website uses cookies to improve user experience. You can manage cookies through your browser settings. Disabling cookies may affect website functionality.


## 6. Information Security


We implement reasonable security measures to protect your information, including encryption, firewalls and restricted access control. However, no transmission or storage method is 100% secure.


## 7. Policy Changes


We may update this privacy policy from time to time. Material changes will be posted on the website with 30 days advance notice.



## 8. Contact Information


For questions or requests regarding this privacy policy, please contact us:


- Company: WYNC News

- Email: [business_email]

- Phone: [business_phone]

- Address: 150 Madison street , oneida, New York, 13421, USA



Data Protection Authority: For complaints, you may contact the Data Protection Authority at the Ministry of Justice

# Accessibility Statement



Last updated:  June 5, 2026



WYNC News is committed to making our services accessible to all users. We strive to implement the Israeli Standard (TI 5568) based on WCAG 2.1 Level AA guidelines.


Accessibility Level: AA (Israeli Standard TI 5568)



## 1. Accessibility Policy


We believe in equal rights and the right of every person to receive information and services independently and equally. This website was designed and built with special emphasis on accessibility for people with disabilities.


## 2. Accessibility Arrangements on the Site


- Keyboard navigation support

- Screen reader compatibility

- Appropriate color contrast

- Flexible and scalable font sizes

- Descriptive image alt text

- Hierarchical heading structure

- Clear and descriptive links

- Support for 200% zoom without content loss





### WCAG 2.1 Compliance


The website complies with WCAG 2.1 Level AA, which includes:


- Perceivable: Information is presented in ways users can perceive

- Operable: Interface components are operable

- Understandable: Information and user interface are understandable

- Robust: Content can be interpreted by a variety of technologies





## 3. Supported Assistive Technologies


- NVDA (Windows)

- JAWS (Windows)

- VoiceOver (Mac/iOS)

- TalkBack (Android)

- Dragon NaturallySpeaking

- Switch navigation




## 4. Accessibility Testing


The website has been tested using:


- Automated accessibility testing tools

- Manual testing with screen readers

- Keyboard-only navigation

- Color contrast verification

- Testing with users with disabilities




## 5. Continuous Improvements


We are continuously working to improve the accessibility of our website and update it according to technological developments and user feedback.



## 6. Contact and Feedback


If you encounter an accessibility issue on the site or need assistance, please contact us:


- Company: WYNC News

- Email: [business_email]

- Phone: [business_phone]



Response time: We respond to accessibility inquiries within 3 business days and work to resolve issues within 10 business days.

- "Services" - Broadcasting & Media provided through the site

## 3. Terms of Use

- Use of the site for lawful purposes only

- No interference with site operations or other users

- No uploading of offensive, illegal, or harmful content

- Respect for copyright and intellectual property rights

- No actions that may compromise site security




## 4. User Obligations

## 6. Limitation of Liability

## 9. Changes to Terms of Use
